summary: The change renames formatPrice to formatMoney in src/money.ts and adds a currency parameter that uses Intl.NumberFormat. invoiceLines now takes an optional currency that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice still imported by cart
findings.problem: This change removes the formatPrice export from src/money.ts. src/cart.ts still imports formatPrice on line 1 and calls it on line 8.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript build fails, and cartTotal cannot show a cart total to customers.
findings.fix: Update src/cart.ts to call formatMoney with a currency. Another option is to keep formatPrice as a wrapper around formatMoney.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: formatMoney now formats through Intl.NumberFormat, which adds thousands separators and handles currency codes. No test in the repository exercises formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: Nothing catches a later regression in invoice amounts that customers see.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines. Cover amounts above 1000 dollars, a non-USD currency and the default currency.
